beats.label: S1 · The impostor sheriff
beats.text: An unnamed ex-con flees New York, arrives in Banshee, and steals the identity of newly-appointed sheriff Lucas Hood after Hood is killed in a bar robbery.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the premise and the identity theft that every future season is built on top of.

beats.label: S1 · Ana is now Carrie
beats.text: The reason he came: his old lover Ana, now living as Carrie Hopewell with a husband and two kids. She refuses to restart the affair that put him in prison.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up the central relationship and the family Carrie is trying to protect from him.

beats.label: S1 · War with Proctor begins
beats.text: Kai Proctor, ex-Amish crime boss who runs Banshee, tries to buy Lucas's loyalty. Lucas answers by nearly beating Proctor's fighter to death in public.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Locks in the show's core antagonism and the YouTube video that later exposes Lucas.

beats.label: S1 · Rabbit is Carrie's father
beats.text: Carrie's father is revealed to be Rabbit, the New York boss they robbed. He wants his diamonds back and Lucas dead; Carrie briefly betrays Lucas to save her family.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The Rabbit reveal reframes the whole series and drives the season two hunt.

beats.label: S1 · Carrie shoots her father
beats.text: Rabbit finds Banshee, kidnaps Carrie's son Max, and lures Lucas into a trade. Carrie chooses Lucas over her father and shoots Rabbit at his outpost.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Carrie's choice to side with Lucas over blood detonates her marriage and drives S2.

beats.label: S1 · Proctor kills the mayor
beats.text: Proctor's revenge bomb at the Kinaho casino accidentally kills Mayor Kendall. Gordon leaves with the children after learning of the affair.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Proctor's escalation and Gordon's departure define the political and family landscape of S2.

beats.label: S1 · The son is watching
beats.text: Hunters discover the real Lucas Hood's body. His son Jason recognises the YouTube fight and knows the sheriff in Banshee is an impostor.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The single loose thread that opens S2: a person outside Banshee who knows the truth.

cliffhanger.text: Rabbit is dead by his own daughter's hand, Proctor has become a killer of civilians as well as criminals, and the real Lucas Hood's body has surfaced. His son Jason has already recognised the impostor wearing his father's badge.
questions: What will Jason Hood do with what he knows?
Can Lucas hold his stolen identity together now that a body has been found?
How far will Proctor go now that he has killed the mayor?

characters.name: Lucas Hood
characters.line: An unnamed ex-con posing as Banshee's sheriff; only Sugar knows the truth.

characters.name: Carrie Hopewell
characters.line: Rabbit's daughter and Lucas's old partner; has just chosen him over her father and been abandoned by her husband.

characters.name: Kai Proctor
characters.line: Ex-Amish crime boss who runs Banshee; killed the mayor with a casino bomb aimed at the Kinaho.

characters.name: Rebecca Bowman
characters.line: Kai's Amish niece leading a secret double life; thrown out of her community and drawn to her uncle's world.

characters.name: Sugar Bates
characters.line: Bar owner and former boxer, the only person in Banshee who knows Lucas is a fraud.

characters.name: Job
characters.line: The hacker and forger who built Lucas's new identity; has moved to Banshee to help.

characters.name: Rabbit
characters.line: New York crime boss and Carrie's father; shot by Carrie at his outpost, presumed dead.

characters.name: Gordon Hopewell
characters.line: Banshee's DA and Carrie's husband; has left with the children after learning of the affair.

characters.name: Jason Hood
characters.line: The real sheriff's son; has watched the YouTube fight and knows the man in Banshee is an impostor.

beats.label: S2 · Racine's soft landing
beats.text: FBI agent Racine's hearing lets Lucas off free but puts the sheriff's department on federal probation. He is really hunting Rabbit, who Racine believes is still alive.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Racine plants the seed that Rabbit survived and that Lucas's cover is thinner than he thinks.

beats.label: S2 · Rebecca becomes his protégée
beats.text: Kai's niece Rebecca is exiled from the Amish and becomes his protégée at the strip club, learning his business as she moves from bystander to accomplice.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Rebecca's shift into Kai's inner circle powers the rest of the series.

beats.label: S2 · Burton kills Jason Hood
beats.text: Jason Hood surfaces demanding a new identity. He sleeps with Rebecca; a jealous Proctor has Burton kill him and dump the body.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Closes the S1 loose thread and hardens the Lucas-Proctor war into personal blood feud.

beats.label: S2 · Racine dies knowing
beats.text: Racine confirms he knows Lucas is an impostor and offers to help take Rabbit down. A sniper kills Racine before the deal can happen.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes the one federal ally who could have brought Rabbit in cleanly.

beats.label: S2 · The diamonds were fake
beats.text: Job cashes in the diamonds Lucas went to prison for and finds them fake. Fifteen years lost for nothing; Rabbit has always been three steps ahead.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reframes Lucas's entire past as a Rabbit setup and drives the final confrontation.

beats.label: S2 · Rabbit finishes himself
beats.text: Rabbit is alive in New York, hiding in his brother Yulish's church. Lucas and Carrie storm it, and a broken Rabbit takes Carrie's gun and shoots himself.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The Rabbit arc actually ends; every future season is post-Rabbit.

beats.label: S2 · Emmett dies, Chayton rises
beats.text: Neo-Nazis gun down deputy Emmett and his wife as they leave town. Rebecca murders Alex Longshadow to break Proctor free; Chayton, in New Orleans, hears and heads for Banshee.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets both S3's central villain and the neo-Nazi grudge that Kurt Bunker will inherit.

cliffhanger.text: Rabbit is finally dead, the diamonds were always fake, and Rebecca has crossed the line into killing for Kai. Emmett has been murdered by white supremacists, Deva has just learned Lucas is her real father, and Chayton Littlestone is on his way back to Banshee to avenge Alex Longshadow.
questions: What will Chayton do when he reaches Banshee?
How far will Rebecca go now that she has killed for her uncle?
Can the sheriff's department hold together after losing Emmett?

characters.name: Lucas Hood
characters.line: Still passing as sheriff; has killed Rabbit and now knows the diamonds that cost him fifteen years were fake.

characters.name: Carrie Hopewell
characters.line: Out of prison and out of her marriage; Deva now knows Lucas is her real father.

characters.name: Kai Proctor
characters.line: Facing federal charges only because Rebecca murdered the one witness who could convict him.

characters.name: Rebecca Bowman
characters.line: Kai's protégée, sleeping with him and freshly a killer on his behalf.

characters.name: Sugar Bates
characters.line: Lucas's confidant, part of every off-book job the crew runs from his bar.

characters.name: Job
characters.line: Hacker back in Banshee, still cleaning up Lucas's problems.

characters.name: Gordon Hopewell
characters.line: Broken by Carrie's return to Lucas; drinking, cheating, coming apart.

characters.name: Brock Lotus
characters.line: Senior deputy trying to hold the department together after Emmett's murder.

characters.name: Siobhan Kelly
characters.line: Deputy in a serious relationship with Lucas; a survivor of her own violent ex.

characters.name: Chayton Littlestone
characters.line: Redbones leader and MMA champion, returning to Banshee to avenge Alex Longshadow.

beats.label: S3 · Chayton returns, Nola dies
beats.text: Chayton and his Redbones ambush a Camp Genoa Marine convoy and take their weapons. Nola attacks Proctor's estate for revenge; Burton kills her in the doorway.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Chayton is loose in Banshee and the Longshadow feud with Proctor is now ended in blood.

beats.label: S3 · Camp Genoa heist forms
beats.text: Lucas, Job, Sugar and Carrie plan a heist on Colonel Stowe's Camp Genoa cash safe. Carrie, unraveling since prison, briefly sleeps with the colonel.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The heist is the season's engine and the reason Stowe will hunt the crew at the end.

beats.label: S3 · Kurt joins, Siobhan learns
beats.text: Former neo-Nazi Kurt Bunker joins the sheriff's department. FBI agent Phillips's file exposes Lucas as an impostor; Siobhan reads it and pulls away from him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Kurt as the season's moral centre and puts Lucas's secret in Siobhan's hands.

beats.label: S3 · Chayton kills Siobhan
beats.text: Chayton and the Redbones assault the sheriff's office. Siobhan kills a Redbone hand to hand but Chayton snaps her neck in front of Lucas.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The death that reshapes Lucas, Brock and the whole rest of the season.

beats.label: S3 · New Orleans execution
beats.text: The Camp Genoa heist succeeds. Lucas and Brock track Chayton to New Orleans; Lucas executes him at the docks in revenge for Siobhan.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Closes the Chayton arc and frees the crew to be hunted by Stowe alone.

beats.label: S3 · Kai left to die, kills alone
beats.text: Frasier's Black Beards abduct Kai and his lover Emily over Rebecca's side deals. Lucas rescues Emily but leaves Kai; Kai kills his captors himself and ends things with Emily.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Kai emerges harder and more alone, which sets his S4 mayoralty and Rebecca's role.

beats.label: S3 · Gordon dies, Job vanishes
beats.text: Stowe rounds up the crew; the assault on his compound kills Gordon and ends with Stowe stabbed to death by Carrie. Job is dragged off by an unseen figure. Lucas resigns as sheriff.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Three status changes at once - widowed Carrie, missing Job, ex-sheriff Lucas - set the whole S4 opening.

cliffhanger.text: Chayton is dead, but the cost was Siobhan and Gordon, with Job taken alive by unknown hands. Lucas has taken off the badge; Carrie is a widow who has killed her lover's captor; Proctor is free and intrigued by the vacuum Lucas is leaving.
questions: Who has Job, and can he be found?
What is Lucas without the sheriff's badge?
Will Proctor fill the vacuum Lucas has just walked away from?

characters.name: Lucas Hood
characters.line: Resigning as sheriff, gutted by Siobhan's death; Deva knows he is her father and they are estranged.

characters.name: Carrie Hopewell
characters.line: Widowed after Gordon died in the raid; killed Stowe herself with a knife.

characters.name: Kai Proctor
characters.line: Free again, his drug pipeline established, his lover Emily gone by his own hand.

characters.name: Rebecca Bowman
characters.line: Kai's second in command, quietly running side deals with the Salvadorans behind him.

characters.name: Sugar Bates
characters.line: Part of the crew now, still running the Forge.

characters.name: Job
characters.line: Kidnapped by one of Stowe's men after the assault on Stowe's compound; taken by an unseen figure.

characters.name: Brock Lotus
characters.line: Senior deputy holding the department together; the likely next sheriff.

characters.name: Kurt Bunker
characters.line: Former neo-Nazi turned deputy who has publicly vowed to bring the Brotherhood down.

characters.name: Deva Hopewell
characters.line: Lucas and Carrie's teenage daughter, sliding after Gordon's death.

beats.label: S4 · Eighteen months later
beats.text: Eighteen months on: Lucas lives in a woodland cabin, Kai is mayor of Banshee allied with the Bunker neo-Nazis, and Carrie fights the syndicate alone as a masked vigilante.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resets the board so the reader knows who holds what power at the start of the season.

beats.label: S4 · Rebecca is dead
beats.text: Brock, now sheriff, pulls Lucas out of the woods to tell him Rebecca has been killed - the third woman in town ritually gutted by a serial killer.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The murder that drags Lucas back into Banshee and drives the whole season.

beats.label: S4 · Job comes back broken
beats.text: Lucas and Carrie find Job after two years of captivity and torture; the entire Camp Genoa score goes to ransom him. He returns alive but wrecked by PTSD.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The S3 kidnap is resolved and the crew's money is gone - both matter for what they do next.

beats.label: S4 · Calvin seizes the Brotherhood
beats.text: Kurt's affair with Calvin Bunker's wife Maggie collides with Calvin's rages. Calvin murders his father-in-law Randall Watts and takes over the Brotherhood by force.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Calvin's ascent is the season's second-front conflict and Kurt's personal war.

beats.label: S4 · Bode's cult falls, killer stays free
beats.text: Lucas, Brock and FBI agent Dawson hunt serial killer Declan Bode and destroy his cult. Bode's pattern does not fit Rebecca - her killer is still walking free.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Pivots the whole investigation off the serial killer plot and back toward Kai's house.

beats.label: S4 · Burton killed Rebecca
beats.text: Lucas finds Rebecca's necklace in a hidden torture shed on Kai's land. At the showdown Burton confesses he killed Rebecca out of loyalty; Lucas beats him, and Kai finishes him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The season's central mystery collapses onto Kai's closest friend and destroys him.

beats.label: S4 · Everyone leaves
beats.text: Kurt shoots Calvin dead to protect Maggie. Kai, empire broken and Burton gone, opens fire on six cartel hitmen alone. Lucas and Job leave Banshee for good.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Final placements: who is dead, who has left, who is standing in the ruins.

cliffhanger.text: Rebecca is buried, her killer buried by Kai's own hand. Kai stands alone against six cartel guns; Lucas has left Banshee and Job has left for New York. Agent Dawson has walked away with a file that names Lucas as an impostor.
questions: Does Kai survive the cartel arriving at his door?
Can Lucas outrun the dossier of his real identity?
What is left of Banshee for Brock, Kurt and Carrie to hold?

characters.name: Lucas Hood
characters.line: Leaving Banshee; his real identity is now in Agent Dawson's file.

characters.name: Carrie Hopewell
characters.line: Alone after Gordon; her masked vigilante war on Kai's syndicate is finished.

characters.name: Kai Proctor
characters.line: Mayor turned pariah, his lieutenant Burton dead, opening fire on cartel hitmen alone at his estate.

characters.name: Rebecca Bowman
characters.line: Murdered by Burton out of loyalty to Kai; buried by Kai in a clearing in the woods.

characters.name: Job
characters.line: Rescued, broken by two years of torture, leaving for New York after gifting Sugar a satchel of cash.

characters.name: Sugar Bates
characters.line: Leaving Banshee for points unknown alongside Hood after a last round at the Forge.

characters.name: Brock Lotus
characters.line: Sheriff of Banshee; the last one standing after everyone else has left or died.

characters.name: Kurt Bunker
characters.line: Deputy who shot Calvin dead to protect Maggie and her son; Brock told him this is how policing works here.

characters.name: Deva Hopewell
characters.line: Back at Carrie's; killed one of Proctor's hit team during a raid on the house and is traumatised by it.
